import tslearn.metrics

path, sim = tslearn.metrics.lcss_path(
    s1, s2, 
    eps=0.5, 
    global_constraint="sakoe_chiba", 
    sakoe_chiba_radius=5
)

assert isinstance(path, list), "Path must be a list"
assert isinstance(sim, float), "Similarity must be a float"
assert 0.0 <= sim <= 1.0, "Similarity must be between 0.0 and 1.0"

if path:
    assert isinstance(path[0], tuple) and len(path[0]) == 2, "Path elements must be 2-tuples"

# LCSS similarity is defined as the length of the matching path divided by the length of the shortest time series
expected_sim = len(path) / min(len(s1), len(s2))
assert abs(sim - expected_sim) < 1e-7, f"Expected similarity {expected_sim}, got {sim}"

print(f"__CHECK__ lcss_path {sim:.4f}, path_len={len(path)}")
